It says a lot when Donald Trump lashes out at his own supporters simply because they are demanding answers and want the Justice Department to release the files related to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Instead of respecting their concerns and recognizing that the American people deserve transparency, Trump calls them “stupid people” and accuses Democrats of duping them. But asking questions about a case involving powerful and wealthy individuals is not stupid; it is a reasonable demand for accountability. This issue should never be about protecting one political party or attacking another. It should be about making sure the truth comes out, the victims are treated with dignity, and anyone who committed a crime is held accountable, regardless of their wealth, political connections, or position in society. If the administration believes there is nothing to hide, then the public deserves a clear explanation of what can legally be released and why any information must remain confidential. Americans should not have to choose between loyalty to a political leader and their right to demand transparency from their government. No president should expect blind obedience from the people who elected him, and no supporter should be insulted for asking legitimate questions. The truth should never be a partisan issue, and accountability should apply to everyone equally. Nobody is above the law, and the American people deserve answers, not insults, distractions, or political name-calling. #EpsteinFiles #ReleaseTheFiles #Accountability #NobodyIsAboveTheLaw #TransparencyMatters
